items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: Bill Elliot... was working with the soprano, conductor Barbara Hannigan... to record an adaptation he did of John Lithgow’s book “The Remarkable Farkle McBride”

ctx.x: Nice. And when we wrap this up, do you have a project that you will turn to that’s sort of in the works?

I have a couple of things in the works. Well I’m doing a new album which is called “The Green World” and I have about half of the songs almost done, not recorded but written. And I’m working on something that — I shouldn’t say the title yet because I’m not entirely sure, but Bill Elliot, who used to have a big band when I was in L.A. and has written a couple of songs with me, was working with the soprano, conductor Barbara Hannigan who is this extraordinary eccentric woman who sings opera and conducts. She won…

Do you have a work pattern? I’ve often read, talking about authors and composers, that you have to have a routine, you have to write something every day even if you have no particular impetus or inspiration, you just have to keep writing. Do you find that is true?
